semantic_findings.description: The topic reference lists create and create-reply commands while the skill presents the content workflow as public and read-oriented. Agents could expose posting actions if they treat every listed command as allowed.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The reference explicitly lists write-capable community commands, and SKILL.md states all commands are public. This is a real side-effect risk, but there is no evidence of malicious intent.

content.user_title: Analyze Longbridge Market News and Filings
content.value_statement: Investors need current market context without mixing news, filings, and discussion into one raw feed. This skill uses Longbridge sources to classify events, summarize SEC filings, and answer core market rule questions.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests to news, filings, community topics, SEC filings, or regulatory rule references.
Summarizes stock news into catalyst, regulatory, strategic, financial, opinion, and other buckets.
Uses Longbridge CLI commands or MCP fallback to retrieve available market content.
Analyzes 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy, Form 4, and major holder filing themes.
Answers general A-share, Hong Kong, and US market rule questions.
Matches responses to Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English.
limitations: Live content requires the Longbridge CLI or a compatible MCP server.
It does not provide financial, legal, tax, or trading advice.
Longbridge coverage may be sparse for small-cap stocks or older events.
Regulatory answers should be checked against official sources before use.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Stock Events
use_cases.description: Track recent stock events across news, filings, and community discussion without reading every raw item.

use_cases.title: Analyze SEC Filing Themes
use_cases.description: Review 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy, and Form 4 themes from Longbridge filing data.

use_cases.title: Explain Market Rules
use_cases.description: Answer common A-share, Hong Kong, and US market rule questions for clients or internal teams.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Latest News
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the latest Longbridge news for {symbol}. Group items by event type and end with key facts only.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Market Signals
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request across multiple content sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: For {symbol}, compare recent news, filings, and community topics. Highlight confirmed facts, sentiment skew, and gaps in coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Filing
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the most recent {filing_type} for {symbol}. Extract metadata, key findings, financial snapshot, risk factors, and investment signal.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a market context brief for {symbol} using Longbridge news, filing, topic, SEC filing, and rule references. Separate facts from interpretation.

output_examples.input: What happened with TSLA.US this week?
output_examples.output: A grouped digest with catalysts, regulatory items, filings, community sentiment, key facts, and a not-investment-advice disclaimer.
A filing summary with metadata, key findings, financial snapshot, risk factor changes, management tone, and a neutral investment signal.
A concise rule explanation with settlement timing, practical impact, and a reminder to verify current exchange guidance.

best_practices: Use full symbols with market suffixes, such as AAPL.US or 700.HK.
State the desired depth, date range, and response language.
Ask for facts first, then request sentiment or interpretation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to make trading decisions or guarantee returns.
Do not paste community comments verbatim as investment evidence.
Do not use write-capable community commands for posting.

faq.question: Does this skill provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes source material and includes a not-investment-advice disclaimer.

faq.question: Which data source does it prefer?
faq.answer: It prefers Longbridge data and uses web search only as a labeled fallback.

faq.question: Can it analyze SEC filings?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements, Form 4, and major holder filings.

faq.question: Does it require login?
faq.answer: Read-oriented flows are documented as public. Posting community content should not be used in this skill.

faq.question: What languages can it use?
faq.answer: It can respond in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, or English to match the user.

faq.question: What happens when data is missing?
faq.answer: It should say the Longbridge dataset is sparse and suggest a labeled fallback search.
